description: Conditions under which the event build's acceptance fails, whatever any agent reports. Each is checked by an existing tool run by the acceptance job at the exact final SHA; none is checked by the implementing agent's own assertion.
finalSha: The SHA of main at the deadline instant (execution-plan clock). Every condition is evaluated against that SHA and the deployment of that SHA.

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: any P0 obligation of the frozen plan is unverified
a critical test (any test bound to a P0 obligation, any PAT test, any invariant test of a normative invariant) fails
conditions.checkedBy: verify-plan over the evidence bundle; acceptance ledger

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: required evidence is missing, or is for another SHA, or from an earlier rehearsal
the deployed artifact's SHA differs from the verified SHA, or the deployed acceptance job for that SHA did not conclude successfully
conditions.checkedBy: deploy smoke (build.json equals the SHA) and the deployed-acceptance job conclusion (DCC-008)

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: any bound test is NOT_RUN, skipped or quarantined (including browser suites that stopped after a failure)
a required security check fails: credential scan, PAT-13 artifact scan, CSP and credential-destination checks
conditions.checkedBy: credential scan with the fixture manifest (DCC-015); PAT-13; INV-21 tests

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: provenance is violated: a candidate file matches a rehearsal file (PAT-13 comparison by the independent verifier) or commits lack work-item trailers
conditions.checkedBy: PAT-13 provenance comparison; Praxis work records

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: a required pull request remains unmerged at the deadline, or main differs from the verified SHA
conditions.checkedBy: git: main at the deadline instant equals the verified SHA

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: an acceptance obligation, binding or amendment differs from the frozen package without an operator approval record
the independent review of the final SHA is missing, or authored by the implementing agent, or reports an unresolved critical finding
an in-scope critical defect class is open or lacks SHA-bound closure evidence
conditions.checkedBy: requirements-compiler verify-defect-closures and assertion-ratchet (base = kickoff) before the candidate freeze (DCC-014)

conditions.acceptanceFailsWhen: conditor ci-policy check fails on the final SHA, or a CI job running bound tests lacks CAUSA_PLAN
